0142D656B227C9CEFE05CA6718C8F3C1: What nobody thought possible is actually going to happen next year. Twenty-five years after the curtain fell, and the Tröckener Kecks bid farewell to their audience with their monumental live album ‘Meer Niet!’, the Kecks are set to perform again next year! The Kecks, known for their electrifying performances and songs such as ‘Nu Of Nooit’, ‘De Jacht Is Mooier Dan De Vangst’, ‘Niemand Thuis’ and ‘Met Hart en Ziel’, will embark on an extensive festival tour from spring ’27, followed in the autumn by a series of gigs on the club circuit. But their very first Belgian gig will be at the AB!
2541D896A3B4D407F6757A01B331DEFC:
In 2027, The Wailers will celebrate the 50th anniversary of Exodus , the legendary album released by Bob Marley & The Wailers in June 1977, and named the greatest album of the 20th century by TIME magazine in 1999. Led by Aston Barrett Jr. , son of legendary bassist Aston “Familyman” Barrett , and featuring vocalist Mitchell Brunings , the band brings the timeless music and powerful messages of Exodus to audiences around the world. The album includes iconic songs such as Jamming , Three Little Birds , One Love , Waiting in Vain , and of course Exodus .

The tour celebrates five decades of reggae history, honouring the legacy of Bob Marley while passing on his universal messages of love, unity, spirituality, resilience, and hope to new generations. Combining musical authenticity with a strong family connection to the original Wailers, Aston Barrett Jr. continues his father's legacy, both on stage and through his portrayal in the biographical film Bob Marley: One Love (2024).

Still creatively active and constantly evolving, The Wailers have earned Grammy nominations for their albums One World and Evolution , blending classic roots reggae with contemporary influences. The Exodus 2027 World Tour is a celebration of a timeless musical legacy and the enduring power of reggae to connect generations. One Love! .
262796355C5D49D100396B1B2546A1A1: Ska, punk rock and a heaping dose of energy: The Interrupters know better than anyone how to get a crowd going. Since 2011, frontwoman Aimee Interrupter and the three Bivona brothers have been combining the infectious rhythms of British 2 Tone ska with the raw energy of Californian punk rock. With Rancid frontman Tim Armstrong as their mentor and producer, the quartet have become a fixture on the punk scene. They’ve toured with acts including Green Day, Bad Religion and Rancid, and have scored major crowd favourites with tracks such as ‘She’s Kerosene’ and ‘Take Back The Power’.
53830D39453D470823DBADF7316FEB70:
With a boundless passion for classic country music and driven by the spirit of early rock ’n’ roll, Drake Milligan is a dynamic artist whose musical heroes are George Strait and Elvis Presley – in other words, the King of Country and the King of Rock ’n’ Roll. His unique take on traditional country music has won over fans, his peers and the media, including Billboard, PEOPLE, American Songwriter, USA Today and Access Hollywood. In 2022, he made a name for himself with his debut album, ‘Dallas/Fort Worth’, which immediately topped the iTunes Country and All-Genre charts. The album saw him reach number five on Billboard’s Emerging Artists Chart, and it was subsequently named by Billboard as one of the ‘Best Country Albums of 2022’. Originally from Fort Worth, Texas, the artist has since performed on programmes such as “The Kelly Clarkson Show” and at iconic venues including The Grand Ole Opry, Stagecoach and the CMA Music Festival. Recently, he made history by becoming the first artist to perform on a Formula 1 circuit during the inaugural ‘F1 Grid Gigs’ in Austin, Texas. Following his high-profile debut, Drake scored a number one hit on Canadian country radio with ‘Honky Tonkin’ About’, featuring The Reklaws.

He continued his momentum into 2024 with his critically and publicly acclaimed EP, ‘Jukebox Song’, which features the fan favourite track ‘I Got A Problem’.
742CD6037A86506A89520DAC43AC7F5A: OCS, The Ohsees, Thee Oh Sees, Oh Sees… whatever name John Dwyer and co. go by when they take to the stage, they’ve been rocking just as hard for nearly thirty years. Today, that endless stream of fuzz, psychedelia and garage punk goes by the name of Osees . With two drummers and loads of live energy that you simply have to experience for yourself.
8885EB774AE67AB55FF68A84445BE8CF: The undisputed kings of ska-punk parody and all things Belgian are celebrating 30 years of madness! Since 1996, this cheerful brass band collective has been turning stages upside down with its absurd humor and outlandish parodies. For this special anniversary, Poulycroc is thinking big and putting together a one-of-a-kind concert!
B5E5DE3973FA0D2365FD80750FE1A402: The American singer-songwriter Greg Freeman has emerged in recent years as a prominent figure on the indie rock and alt-country scenes. Based in Burlington, Vermont, he released his debut album I Looked Out in 2022, which, without a major promotional campaign, gradually found its way to a wider audience. Following the highly acclaimed Burninger (2025), his third album, All Set the Bone, recorded with producer John Congleton (St. Vincent, Sharon Van Etten), was released in October 2026. Freeman combines jangly guitars and Americana with a distinctive raw voice and personal lyrics. The new album has already been awarded a solid 8.5 by Pitchfork.
BFAE46FC9C04B51DD86B63C6A3E79124:
Do you want to improve your Dutch and do you enjoy singing? Then you’ve come to the right place! Every month, together with two musicians and a set list full of Dutch-language classics, we head to a different community centre in Brussels. There, we practise Dutch together – whilst singing!

Through Dutch-language songs, you’ll get to know the language better in a fun and accessible way. At the same time, you’ll discover more about Belgian culture and meet new people. Three birds with one stone!

And don’t worry: you don’t have to be Ann Christy or Clouseau. Fun and enthusiasm are what matter most. You don’t need to be a talented singer!

As we do every year, we’ll round off the season with a spectacular finale at the AB Club!

We’ll provide a pianist, a lead singer, the song lyrics and a free drink. Everyone’s welcome and the sessions are free. Registration is compulsory, though.

Take a look at our schedule and find out when we’ll be singing near you. Want to warm up your vocal cords in advance? Check out this season’s setlist here !

In collaboration with the Taalunie , Theater van A tot Z and the Flemish Community Commission (VGC) .
